short_description: Warmup, mailbox health, deliverability, campaign analytics, and consented-contact management.
long_description: WarmySender in ChatGPT checks email warmup, mailbox health and deliverability, reads campaign analytics, and manages contacts you already have and have permission to mail. You can list mailboxes, read warmup stats, change warmup settings inside the safe ramp, inspect why a campaign sent little or nothing, edit contacts already in the workspace, and maintain the suppression list. Connecting or disconnecting accounts stays in the WarmySender app. No tool here can raise a sending limit. ChatGPT sees this reduced set only; other agents keep the full catalog.

authentication.notes: Client registers itself, user signs in to WarmySender in the browser. No API key is required for ChatGPT.

demo_account.login_url: https://warmysender.com/review-login?token=<shared privately with the reviewer; never committed>
demo_account.notes: Open the login URL the owner pastes into the review form. The browser is signed in as the review user and lands on the dashboard. There is no password step. The token lives only on the WarmySender host.

starter_prompts: Which mailboxes are still warming up, and what is each one's health?
Show warmup stats for the workspace and the two mailboxes with the lowest arriving-mail counts.
List my email campaigns and explain any that sent little or nothing recently.
Show the contacts already in this workspace on the 'Customers' list and suppress anyone who asked to stop.
List my custom tracking domains and tell me which still need a CNAME.

positive.prompt: What workspace am I connected to and what can this connection do?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_workspace_info; reports workspace name, scopes and account status. Does not show a billing link.
positive.expected_result_shape: Workspace summary object without plan-checkout fields.

positive.prompt: How is warmup going, and which mailboxes need a look?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_warmup_stats and list_mailboxes (and get_mailbox_health if one mailbox is named).
positive.expected_result_shape: Warmup totals plus per-mailbox status and health.
positive.fixture: Demo workspace with at least two connected mailboxes, one warming.

positive.prompt: List my email campaigns and explain any that sent little or nothing recently.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_campaigns, then get_campaign and/or list_skipped_actions for quiet ones. Does not create or start a campaign.
positive.expected_result_shape: Campaign list with counters; skipped-action groups for quiet campaigns.
positive.fixture: Demo workspace with at least two campaigns, one quiet.

positive.prompt: Show contacts already on the 'Customers' list and update Jane Doe's title to Director.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_prospects (filter by list) then update_prospect for the named contact already in the workspace.
positive.expected_result_shape: Paged contacts; then the updated contact.
positive.fixture: Demo workspace with a 'Customers' list and a contact named Jane Doe.

positive.prompt: List my tracking domains and say which are verified.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_tracking_domains; reports verification status and the CNAME target.
positive.expected_result_shape: Array of tracking domains with status.
positive.fixture: Demo workspace with at least one custom tracking domain.

negative.prompt: Create a brand-new email campaign called Demo Q4 and start it.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses politely. create_campaign / start_campaign are not on the ChatGPT tool list; if called they return the ChatGPT refusal sentence. Offers to read existing campaigns instead.
negative.reason: Campaign create and launch are excluded for ChatGPT.

negative.prompt: Open campaign 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 (an id from another workspace).
negative.expected_behavior: Calls get_campaign; the server answers not_found. Does not invent data and does not search outside this workspace.
negative.reason: Cross-workspace ids must resolve as not_found.

negative.prompt: Set this mailbox's warmup daily volume to 10,000 so it skips the safe ramp.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls update_warmup_settings; the server refuses to raise the sending limit past the safe ramp. The tool description already says it cannot raise a sending limit.
negative.reason: Warmup safety limits cannot be bypassed from ChatGPT.
